description: TV Caduceus public lever: sync/build/install caduceus from main (dual-snake cert face), converge profile/routes, install additive caduceus_staff house_ca Python snake, stand up caduceus.service.

managed_files.content:
[Unit]
Description=Caduceus LAN-open appliance API (TV)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/caduceus serve
Environment=CADUCEUS_BIND=0.0.0.0:8787
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

schema: caduceus.profile.v1
profile: tv
capability:
  household_verifying_key:
  default_ttl_seconds: 60
mode: tv
harmonia_profile: /etc/harmonia/profiles/tv/index.json
commands:
- help
- identity show
- profile show
- health
- receipts latest
- update status
- update check
- update now
- update service status
- update service toggle
- staff intent
- cert status
- cert issue-leaf
- cert rotate-ca
- cert bundle create
services:
  update:
    timer: harmonia.timer
    latest_receipt: /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/update-latest/run.json
harmonia_routes:
  update_now:
    bin: /usr/local/bin/harmonia
    args:
    - tv-update
    - /etc/harmonia/profiles/tv/index.json
    - --apply
    - --receipt-dir
    - /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/update-latest
  update_check:
    bin: /usr/local/bin/harmonia
    args:
    - tv-update
    - /etc/harmonia/profiles/tv/index.json
    - --receipt-dir
    - /var/lib/harmonia/receipts/tv-check-latest
operator_aliases:
  update: caduceus update now
  update-check: caduceus update check
  update-status: caduceus update status
  health: caduceus health

{
  "schema": "caduceus.policy.v1",
  "profile": "tv",
  "allowed_public_actions": [
    "identity show",
    "profile show",
    "health",
    "receipts latest",
    "update status",
    "update check",
    "update now",
    "update service status",
    "update service toggle on",
    "update service toggle off",
    "cert status",
    "cert issue-leaf",
    "cert rotate-ca",
    "cert bundle create"
  ],
  "private_land_organs_exposed": false
}
